## Elective courses

Students must get 18 credits (CFUIECTS) by choosing two courses from the following list.

To obtain the required 18 CTU/ECTS, students need to choose a maximum of one course in the M-PSI/O6 or SPS/O9 or SECS-P/01 areas.

| Advanced Strategic Management             | SECS-P/O7                |
|-------------------------------------------|--------------------------|
| Comparative industrial relations          | SPSI09                   |
| Compensation and benefit                  | SECS-P/1O                |
| Conflict Management and Negotiation       | M-PSI/O6                 |
| Empirical methods for inequality analysis | SECS-P/O1                |
| Learning and development                  | M-PSI/O6                 |
| Organizational innovation and technology  | (3) SECS-P/O8, SECS-P/1O |
| Organizational Transformation and Change  | SECS-P/1O                |
